messages.subject: Re: integration of parental linkage maps?
parts:
Hello guys 

I think my question was a bit silly and for this remained unanswered. 
However I found you can integrate the parental linkage maps. 

- You make one map for each parent
- You insert the common markers
- You find the linkage group of the parent1 associated  with linkage groups of the parent2 
- You combine the raw data 
-  You re-calculate the map

Best, 
Loukas
